title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
abstract: arXiv:2611.18527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators offer massive compute capacity through hundreds of thousands of processing elements (PEs) interconnected across a single wafer, but realizing this potential requires efficient application mapping. Their scale makes programming these systems and mapping applications onto them challenging. Existing approaches rely on template-based mappings to maintain productivity, but these templates restrict the mapping design space. In particular, they impose fixed geometric layouts over the PE grid, often leaving compute and memory resources underutilized.   In this work, we present WaferTetris, a system that removes these geometric restrictions through freeform mapping. Its Tetris-like strategy flexibly packs computation across the wafer, improving PE utilization and usable memory capacity while preserving PE-task code. translated_title: WaferTetris：晶圆级加速器上的高效自由形状映射
translated_abstract: 晶圆级加速器通过单片晶圆上互连的数十万个处理单元（PE）提供巨大的计算能力，但要发挥这一潜力需要高效的应用映射。其庞大的规模使得对这些系统进行编程以及将应用映射到其上变得极具挑战性。现有方法依赖于基于模板的映射来保持开发效率，但这些模板限制了映射的设计空间。特别是，它们在PE网格上强加了固定的几何布局，往往导致计算和内存资源利用不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了WaferTetris，一个通过自由形状映射消除这些几何限制的系统。其类俄罗斯方块的策略灵活地在整个晶圆上打包计算，在保留PE-任务代码的同时提高了PE利用率和可用内存容量。我们开发了一个基于递推的吞吐量模型，该模型捕获分支-汇合依赖关系以指导空间……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出了WaferTetris系统，通过类俄罗斯方块的自由形状映射策略打破模板固定几何布局的限制，灵活地在晶圆级加速器上打包计算，从而提升处理单元利用率和可用内存容量。
en_tdlr: WaferTetris introduces a Tetris-like freeform mapping approach that removes the fixed geometric layout constraints of template-based methods, flexibly packing computations across wafer-scale accelerators to improve PE utilization and usable memory capacity.
